objective: Repair EXP-SSI-697354 as a versioned successor contract EXP-SSI-9b542d per DEC-20260806-a00a28's next_action. That decision rejected the prior contract on two grounds: (1) its blocking reproduction gate asserts a band the contract's own cost model cannot produce under the configuration it declares, because the vOW law does not reduce to T_full at w=M and is uniformly ~46 bits attacker-favourable at NIST-I; (2) of 14 declared assertions, ZERO can return a negative about the mathematical object -- this is the binding defect. tasks.title: Repair: EXP-SSI-9b542d, a versioned successor to EXP-SSI-697354

handoff.objective: Produce EXP-SSI-9b542d, a frozen successor to EXP-SSI-697354 that fixes both grounds DEC-20260806-a00a28 rejected it on, verified by you before you freeze it -- not left for the next reviewer to discover unfixed.
inputs: EXP-SSI-697354/specification.yaml (the rejected contract, to be superseded not edited)
DEC-20260806-a00a28 rationale and next_actions (four repair requirements, verbatim)
EV-SSI-455241 observations OBJ-1, OBJ-2, and the control-capability finding
constraints: THIS IS A NEW RECORD, NOT AN EDIT. EXP-SSI-697354 is immutable. Write experiments/EXP-SSI-9b542d/specification.yaml as a new file that names supersedes: EXP-SSI-697354 and states what changed and why.

FIX 1 -- THE ANCHOR ERROR. experiments/EXP-WESOVOW-001/cost_model.py computes T_full/sqrt(min(w,M)), the square root of a memory COUNT not a RATIO, and does not reduce to T_full at w=M. Do NOT import that formula. Derive and state your own vOW charging INSIDE this contract's specification, prove in the repair_report that it reduces to T_full at w=M (show the algebra, not just an assertion), and declare explicitly which of MC_P13 / MC_VOW / a third corrected form you adopt and why. EXP-WESOVOW-001 itself is a separate committed record with its own defect; flag in repair_report that it needs a superseding experiment under whatever goal owns it, but do not attempt that here -- out of this task's write_scope.

FIX 2 -- THE REPRODUCTION GATE. Recompute the gate's asserted band from the corrected vOW law under the EXACT configuration the gate declares (unbounded memory, memoryless baseline). The band must be a consequence of your formula, not a copied number from the rejected contract.

FIX 3 -- THE BINDING DEFECT. At least one control must be CAPABLE OF FAILING about the mathematical object itself, not just about parsing or units. The rejected contract's 14 assertions were all incapable of a negative verdict (EV-SSI-455241's central finding). Design at least one arm whose FAILURE is a live, non-degenerate outcome under a plausible wrong model -- and verify by computing both the pass and the fail case yourself, showing both in repair_report.md. A control you cannot make fail on some input is not evidence the control works; it is evidence you have not tried.
FIX 4 -- MECHANICAL. Add `re` and `ast` to stdlib_modules_permitted. Move the w grid (currently only in H-SSI-7fe2bf line 500) into the frozen specification itself.

IDEA-20260806-62ba9d's quantitative claims (1.585-2.585 bits, 32-43% sota_delta) were WITHDRAWN by DEC-20260806-a00a28. Do not cite them. Its structural observation (Section 4.1 prices OneEnd, not Isogeny) may still be cited.

SCOPE DISCIPLINE UNCHANGED FROM THE PARENT CONTRACT: cost-model result on an extrapolated estimator, not an executed attack. No security claim about SQIsign. Affected-vs-safe scope stated per axis, not as a single unqualified sentence -- the corrected finding is that the gap GROWS with level (9.5387/21.9537/38.8387 bits at NIST-I/III/V) and only memory feasibility favours III/V.

Dependency check yourself before freezing: verify by attempting the imports your contract needs actually work in this environment. Do not assert availability from a prior task card -- the dispatcher has twice now asserted 'numpy is present' incorrectly.
This task SPECIFIES and APPROVES. It runs nothing, changes no goal status, promotes nothing. Do not commit.
